latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Integrates Perchance image generation with OpenClaw.

- Send text prompts to Perchance.org and display generated images.
- Supports prompt customization with orientation options (landscape, portrait, square).
- Includes enhanced error handling and user-friendly error messages.
- Enables multiple image generation and progress indicators.
- Provides terminal support for OpenClaw users.
